def clean_comment(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        text = str(text)
    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
        text = text[1:-1]
    text = (
        text.replace("\\n", " ")
        .replace("\\t", " ")
        .replace("\\\\", " ")
        .replace("\\r", " ")
        .replace('"', " ")
    )
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    return text.lower()

def extract_insult_voc_features(text):
    words = text.lower().split()
    features = {}

    features["insult_word_count"] = sum(
        1
        for w in words
        if any(re.match(rf"^\b{insult}\b", w, re.IGNORECASE) for insult in INSULT_VOCAB)
    )

    features["insult_word_ratio"] = features["insult_word_count"] / max(len(words), 1)

    features["sexual_insult_flag"] = (
        1
        if any(
            re.match(rf"^\b{insult}\b", w, re.IGNORECASE)
            for w in words
            for insult in ["bitch", "slut", "faggot", "cunt"]
        )
        else 0
    )

def extract_temporal_features(date_str):
    if pd.isna(date_str) or not isinstance(date_str, str):
        return {
            "hour": np.nan,
            "day_of_month": np.nan,
            "is_weekend": np.nan,
            "day_of_week": np.nan,
            "month": np.nan,
        }

    features = {}
    try:
        hour = int(date_str[9:11]) if len(date_str) >= 11 else np.nan
        features["hour"] = hour
    except (ValueError, IndexError):
        features["hour"] = np.nan

    try:
        day_of_month = int(date_str[6:8]) if len(date_str) >= 8 else np.nan
        features["day_of_month"] = day_of_month
    except (ValueError, IndexError):
        features["day_of_month"] = np.nan

    try:
        month = int(date_str[3:5]) if len(date_str) >= 5 else np.nan
        features["month"] = month
    except (ValueError, IndexError):
        features["month"] = np.nan

    try:
        date_part = date_str[:8]
        year = int(date_part[0:4])
        month = int(date_part[4:6])
        day = int(date_part[6:8])
        date_obj = datetime(year, month, day)
        day_of_week = date_obj.weekday()
        features["day_of_week"] = day_of_week
        features["is_weekend"] = day_of_week >= 5
    except (ValueError, IndexError):
        features["day_of_week"] = np.nan
        features["is_weekend"] = np.nan

    return features

def extract_pattern_features(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        text = str(text)

    features = {}

    features["excl_count"] = text.count("!")
    features["quest_count"] = text.count("?")
    features["period_count"] = text.count(".")

    excl_burst = len(re.findall(r"!{2,}", text))
    features["excl_burst"] = excl_burst

    quest_burst = len(re.findall(r"\?{2,}", text))
    features["quest_burst"] = quest_burst

    punctuation_count = (
        features["excl_count"] + features["quest_count"] + features["period_count"]
    )
    features["punctuation_ratio"] = punctuation_count / max(len(text), 1)
    features["punctuation_ratio_per_word"] = punctuation_count / max(
        len(text.split()), 1
    )

    features["capital_count"] = sum(1 for c in text if c.isupper())
    words = text.split()
    if len(words) > 0:
        features["uppercase_word_ratio"] = sum(1 for w in words if w.isupper()) / len(
            words
        )
        features["capital_start_ratio"] = sum(1 for w in words if w[0].isupper()) / len(
            words
        )
        consecutive_cap_words = sum(1 for w in words if w.isupper() and len(w) > 2)
        features["shouting_word_ratio"] = consecutive_cap_words / max(len(words), 1)
        multi_cap_words = sum(
            1 for w in words if len(w) > 1 and sum(1 for c in w if c.isupper()) > 1
        )
        features["multi_cap_word_ratio"] = multi_cap_words / max(len(words), 1)
    else:
        features["uppercase_word_ratio"] = 0
        features["capital_start_ratio"] = 0
        features["shouting_word_ratio"] = 0
        features["multi_cap_word_ratio"] = 0

    word_lengths = [len(w) for w in words]
    if len(word_lengths) > 0:
        features["avg_word_length"] = np.mean(word_lengths)
        features["max_word_length"] = max(word_lengths)
        features["min_word_length"] = min(word_lengths)
        features["std_word_length"] = np.std(word_lengths)
        features["short_word_ratio"] = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) <= 3) / len(words)
        features["long_word_ratio"] = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 5) / len(words)
        features["short_long_ratio"] = sum(1 for w in words if len(w) <= 3) / max(
            sum(1 for w in words if len(w) > 5), 1
        )
    else:
        features["avg_word_length"] = 0
        features["max_word_length"] = 0
        features["min_word_length"] = 0
        features["std_word_length"] = 0
        features["short_word_ratio"] = 0
        features["long_word_ratio"] = 0
        features["short_long_ratio"] = 0

    if len(words) > 0:
        features["you_count"] = sum(
            1 for w in words if re.match(r"^you$|^your$|^yours$", w.lower())
        )
        features["i_count"] = sum(1 for w in words if re.match(r"^i$", w.lower()))
        features["personal_pronoun_ratio"] = (
            features["you_count"] + features["i_count"]
        ) / len(words)

        features["direct_address_words"] = len(
            re.findall(r"you\b|you\'re|yourselves$", text.lower())
        )

        features["intensifier_near_you"] = 0
        for i, w in enumerate(words):
            if re.match(r"^you$", w.lower()):
                for j in range(max(0, i - 2), min(i + 2, len(words))):
                    if (
                        words[j].lower() in INSULT_VOCAB
                        or words[j].lower() in common_stopwords
                    ):
                        features["intensifier_near_you"] += 1
                        break

        features["excl_near_you"] = 0
        for i, w in enumerate(words):
            if re.match(r"^you$", w.lower()):
                for j in range(max(0, i - 2), min(i + 2, len(words))):
                    if re.findall(r"!+", text[j : j + 5]):
                        features["excl_near_you"] += 1
                        break

        features["insult_intensity_score"] = (
            features["capital_count"] + features["excl_count"] + features["quest_count"]
        ) / max(len(words), 1)
    else:
        features["you_count"] = 0
        features["i_count"] = 0
        features["personal_pronoun_ratio"] = 0
        features["direct_address_words"] = 0
        features["intensifier_near_you"] = 0
        features["excl_near_you"] = 0
        features["insult_intensity_score"] = 0

    content_words = [
        w for w in words if len(w) >= 3 and w.lower() not in common_stopwords
    ]
    stop_words_in_text = sum(
        1 for w in words if len(w) >= 2 and w.lower() in common_stopwords
    )
    features["content_word_ratio"] = len(content_words) / max(len(words), 1)
    features["stop_word_ratio"] = stop_words_in_text / max(len(words), 1)
    features["content_stop_ratio"] = len(content_words) / max(stop_words_in_text, 1)

    unique_words = set(words)
    features["unique_word_ratio"] = len(unique_words) / max(len(words), 1)

    func_words = ["re", "or", "as", "if", "when", "where", "why", "how", "than", "but"]
    func_count = sum(1 for w in words if w in func_words)
    features["func_word_ratio"] = func_count / max(len(words), 1)

    features["num_count"] = sum(1 for w in words if w.isdigit())
    features["url_count"] = len(re.findall(r"http[s]?://|\w{3,}://", text))
    features["email_count"] = len(re.findall(r"\w+@\w+\.\w+", text))

    if len(text) >= 2:
        char_bigrams = [
            text[i] + text[i + 1] for i in range(len(text) - 1) if i + 1 < len(text)
        ]
        features["bigram_repeats"] = sum(v for c, v in Counter(char_bigrams).items())
        features["unique_bigrams"] = len(Counter(char_bigrams))
        features["top_bigram_ratio"] = (
            Counter(char_bigrams).most_common(10)[0][1] / max(len(char_bigrams), 1)
            if char_bigrams
            else 0
        )
    else:
        features["bigram_repeats"] = 0
        features["unique_bigrams"] = 0
        features["top_bigram_ratio"] = 0

    if len(text) >= 3:
        char_trigrams = [
            text[i] + text[i + 1] + text[i + 2]
            for i in range(len(text) - 2)
            if i + 2 < len(text)
        ]
        features["trigram_repeats"] = sum(v for c, v in Counter(char_trigrams).items())
        features["unique_trigrams"] = len(Counter(char_trigrams))
        features["top_trigram_ratio"] = (
            Counter(char_trigrams).most_common(5)[0][1] / max(len(char_trigrams), 1)
            if char_trigrams
            else 0
        )
    else:
        features["trigram_repeats"] = 0
        features["unique_trigrams"] = 0
        features["top_trigram_ratio"] = 0

    features["cap_then_excl"] = len(re.findall(r"[A-Z]!", text))
    features["lower_then_excl"] = len(re.findall(r"[a-z]!", text))
    features["period_in_upper"] = len(re.findall(r"([A-Z])\.", text))

    features["question_mark_ratio"] = features["quest_count"] / max(
        len(text.split()), 1
    )
    features["excl_period_combo"] = len(re.findall(r"\.!", text))
    features["excl_q_combo"] = len(re.findall(r"\?!", text))

    return features
